scope: exercises the vendored MultiFold loop with the ported PET2 on both step schemas, on SYNTHETIC arrays. No result, no adoption.

backend.reason: Keras-3 TensorFlow with the tf_keras shim: the shim is selected.

E2_engine_used_his_optimizer.note: MultiFold.get_optimizer hardcodes tf.keras.optimizers.Adam; without the subclass his architecture would train under our optimizer and the arm would not be his configuration

intended.warmup_fraction_source: 1000/250000 from his reference run; the FRACTION is preserved, not the absolute count
intended.budget_caveat: n_data is the measured leg's full inventory and is not set by --max-events. Taking n_data = n_mc gives 1.6x the presentations the previous fit-only model assumed, which would put our arm's projected evaluation cost ABOVE the feature contract's independently measured 1.1-1.3 GPU-h for a nominal train. The two cannot both be right, so n_data must be read off a production run's loader meta before the campaign is costed. Reported conditionally until then.
intended.derived_not_copied: max_steps comes from the shared example budget divided by this arm's own batch, not from his --max_steps 250000

E7_realized_policy_matches_the_plan.criterion: every fit must present the intended example budget to within one update; the budget is the fairness axis and a silent shortfall in one arm is an unequal comparison

E4_empty_event_finite.note: a real production state: an event with no recoil tokens. The upstream's -1e9 additive mask keeps this finite where -inf would give NaN
